page.metaTitle: Target Price Tracker & Stock Alerts | WebMonitor.fyi
page.metaDescription: Track Target prices, RedCard discounts, and stock with automated alerts. Catch Cartwheel deals and restocks without checking manually. Two-minute setup.
page.h1: Target price tracker with stock alerts
page.subtitle: Set up a Target product monitor in two minutes. Get alerts on price drops, RedCard discounts, and stock changes.
page.intro: WebMonitor.fyi tracks Target product pages and alerts you on price drops, restocks, and listing changes. The Target price tracker handles Cartwheel offers, RedCard promotions, weekly deals, and clearance pricing on whatever cadence you pick.

features.title: Cartwheel and weekly-deal detection
features.body: Target rotates promotions frequently. Catch the price change on the next check after it goes live, not when you remember to look.

features.title: Clearance threshold alerts
features.body: Set a price floor and get notified when a clearance item crosses it.

features.title: Stock and store-pickup tracking
features.body: Watch for restocks on out-of-stock items and pickup availability changes at your selected store.

features.title: Cross-retailer comparison
features.body: Run parallel monitors on Target, Amazon, Walmart, and Best Buy for the same SKU.

steps.title: Paste the Target product URL
steps.body: Click Add New Monitor and drop in the product page link.

steps.title: Write the criterion
steps.body: Examples: "Alert me when this drops below $25." "Notify me on any Cartwheel discount." "Let me know when this is back in stock for pickup at my store."

steps.title: Pick a frequency
steps.body: 30-minute checks (Pro) for limited-quantity deals; six-hour or daily for steady tracking.

steps.title: Receive alerts
steps.body: Email, Slack, or webhook — your choice.

useCases: Catch Cartwheel and weekly-deal pricing when it activates
Track Target clearance markdowns past a specific price floor
Monitor exclusive collections (Target collaborations) for restocks
Compare Target pricing to Amazon and Walmart on the same SKU
Watch a kids' product or seasonal item for back-to-school deals
page.limits: WebMonitor reads the public Target product page. RedCard-only pricing visible after login, app-only Circle offers, and personalized prices are outside scope.

faq.q: Can I track Target Cartwheel discounts?
faq.a: When the discount renders on the product page, yes. Cartwheel offers shown on the public page trigger an alert the same way any price change does.

faq.q: Does this work for Target exclusive collections?
faq.a: Yes. Many Target exclusives sell out in hours — a 30-minute check interval (Pro) with a Slack alert is the standard setup for restock tracking on these.

faq.q: Can I monitor Target store pickup availability?
faq.a: When the page surfaces pickup availability for your store, yes. Set the criterion to watch for "available for pickup".
WebMonitor uses standard web requests with reasonable intervals. Target pages remain accessible at the cadences we offer. Aggressive sub-minute polling is not supported by design.
